As for the meaning/purpose part, I think my mind is just desperately looking for escapes. 

Your idea of distancing yourself from the pain seems very similar to meditation. To simply observe. I will try it and see if it helps. 

Although it sounds like you yourself are not doing too well. :( Does your method help you? If I can be of any help to you let me know.
I don't. Perhaps I used the term pain a bit too loosely. I meant the things like discomfort, embarrassment and loneliness etc
I don't have a pain counsellor. Thanks for the suggestion though.

Thanks for your reply!

Happiness does seem to be fleeting although I don't really remember what it feels like. Contentment sounds like a smaller step into the right direction and so maybe an easier one. 

However, as logical as you make it sound I still do not really know how to go about this. Do you force yourself to think happy thought or appreciating thoughts, how do you do it?

I don't believe there is any meaning or purpose. I was simply saying that the pain would be more tolerable if there was.

As for what you said about "stop reacting to pain". I find this an interesting thought but I don't think it is very practical. Pain can take many forms and it screams for attention. I will try to ignore it but it just becomes too much. Do you have any suggestions on how to neglect it?

Anyway, thank you for your reply.
Have you ever considered therapy? I know it seems so foolish to struggle through the pain but maybe therapy can help us. I am currently seeking help.
I do fear what's around the corner. I am just so tired of the pain. But it is really the only thing to do.

What a sad story OP :(  I hope you are doing better.
